# QS-CFW-5349-60 — Quality specification - track link CFW-5349-60 (15B37)

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1  
Parts: CFW-5349-60

Scope
This quality specification defines the acceptance criteria, inspection methods, and nonconformance handling for track link CFW-5349-60 (CFW-5349-60) forgings produced at Plant P1. It applies to all production lots and incoming inspection of finished forgings prior to heat treatment release and shipping.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement | Acceptance |
|---|---:|---|
| Hardness | The hardness range for track link CFW-5349-60 (CFW-5349-60) is 31-35 HRC. | All measured locations must fall within the stated range. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for track link CFW-5349-60 (CFW-5349-60) is ±0.03 mm. | Diameters must be within nominal ± tolerance as stated. |
| Forging weight | The maximum forging weight for track link CFW-5349-60 (CFW-5349-60) is 58.0 kg. | Parts exceeding maximum weight are rejected. |

Inspection method
- Hardness: Perform Rockwell hardness testing per shop standard using calibrated testers. Record individual location readings and report conformance to the hardness requirement stated above.
- Bore diameter: Measure bores using calibrated bore gauges or micrometers verified to shop calibration standards. Ensure measurements are assessed against the bore diameter tolerance stated above.
- Weight: Weigh each part on calibrated scales and compare to the maximum forging weight stated above. Verify scale calibration traceability prior to use.
- Sampling: Inspect 100% for the three characteristics listed. Record results on the production inspection record and attach to lot documentation.

Nonconformance handling
- Any part failing to meet the hardness, bore diameter tolerance, or maximum forging weight requirements shall be segregated and documented as nonconforming.
- Nonconforming parts shall be dispositioned by Quality: rework if feasible and demonstrated to meet requirements, or scrap. Rework requires documented method and re-inspection to confirm compliance with the requirements above.
- All nonconformance records shall be retained per plant retention policy and linked to the lot.
